## QA Run 17 — Frontend Playwright sweep — 0 bugs

**Pages walked (14):** dashboard, storm-map, pipeline, leads, lead-detail, estimates, invoices, work-orders, tasks, calendar, reports, canvassing, content-studio (not implemented — planned feature, not a bug), settings.

**Settings tabs walked (14):** Profile, Company, Billing, Payments, Team, Storm Alerts, Notifications, Email/SMTP, Financing, Automations, Drip Sequences, Custom Fields, Pricing/Line Items, Contracts, Reviews — all render with proper content or empty states.

**Console:** 0 new errors. The same 3 pre-token-attach 401s on `/api/properties/import-progress`, `/api/notifications/unread-count`, `/api/crm/tenant-settings` (carry-over #7 from Run 16) — known, not a regression.

**Icon library:** clean. Zero non-Heroicons imports, zero solid/20 variants. The recent icon-replacement commits (`ba79211`, `88e9dfe`) are sticking.

**Commits:** 0. Nothing to fix.

This is the **third consecutive 0-bug overnight QA run** (Runs 15, 16 API; Run 17 frontend). Resume file at `memory/overnight_resume.md` updated with full breakdown + carry-overs and a recommendation that the next run target browser-interactive write flows (the biggest remaining gap, last truly exercised in Run 6).
